data.one_liner: A candlestick chart supporting pinch-to-zoom, panning, and overlays.
data.what_it_does: Provides a candlestick chart widget that supports hand gestures like pinch-to-zoom and panning, as well as mouse scroll wheel zooming on web and desktop. It includes features for dark mode, overlays, custom styles, and multiple trend lines.
use_when: You need to display financial candlestick charts in your Flutter app.
Users need to interact with charts via pinch-to-zoom, panning, and tap events.
avoid_when: You need standard line, bar, or pie charts instead of financial candlestick charts.
strengths: Supports touch gestures (pinch-to-zoom, panning) and mouse scroll wheel for web/desktop.
Includes customizable styles, dark mode support, and trend lines.
weaknesses: Limited to candlestick charts and financial trend data.

alternatives.name: fl_chart
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a wider variety of chart types like line, bar, and pie charts.

alternatives.name: syncfusion_flutter_charts
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need an enterprise-grade charting library with financial and technical indicators.

data.minimal_example:
InteractiveChart(
  candles: [
    CandleData(
      timestamp: DateTime.now().millisecondsSinceEpoch,
      open: 100.0,
      high: 110.0,
      low: 90.0,
      close: 105.0,
      volume: 1000,
    ),
  ],
)
